candidate.definition_en: To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تبني حاجة تاني من الأول بعد ما اتكسرت أو اتهدمت، سواء بيت أو حتى حياتك.

senses.definition_en: To build a structure again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
senses.definition_ar: إعادة بناء مبنى أو منشأة بعد تضررها أو هدمها.
examples: The city had to rebuild after the fire.

senses.definition_en: To restore, revive, or develop something non-physical again, such as trust, life, or an economy.
senses.definition_ar: استعادة أو إعادة تأسيس شيء معنوي كالثقة أو الحياة أو الاقتصاد.
examples: It takes time to rebuild trust in a relationship.
The government promised to rebuild the shattered economy.
The city had to rebuild after the fire.
It takes time to rebuild trust in a relationship.
The government promised to rebuild the shattered economy.
candidate.mnemonic: المقطع 'Re' يعني تاني، و 'Build' يعني يبني.. يبقى المعنى يبني تاني.
